items.title: Salmonella outbreak from jalapeños triggers recalls of salsas, guacamole and pico de gallo sold at HEB, Whole Foods, Walmart, Target, Trader Joe's, Kroger, Stop & Shop and Hannaford
items.why: Discard or return the recalled pico de gallo, salsas, guacamole, stuffed mushrooms and soup mixes with the listed UPCs and best-by dates from stores including HEB, Whole Foods, Walmart, Target, Trader Joe's, Kroger, Stop & Shop and Hannaford — 345 people across 27 states are sick and the investigation is ongoing.

items.title: CPSC recalls 250,000 Cooluli mini-fridges whose electrical switch can short-circuit and start fires
items.why: Unplug and stop using 10- or 15-liter Cooluli mini-fridges with batch numbers 1535–1545 or 1200000–1202080 (Infinity, Classic, Glow Beauty and Vibe series) and contact Cooluli for a free replacement cord — there are 19 reports of smoking, sparking and fires with over $80,000 in property damage.

items.title: CISA confirms active exploitation of a Windows WinSock privilege-escalation flaw and adds it to the known-exploited catalog
items.why: Install the August 2026 Windows security updates now — the WinSock driver flaw CVE-2026-68820 is being actively exploited, and Cisco ASA/FTD (CVE-2026-20349) and Metabase (CVE-2026-72898) are on the same known-exploited list.

items.title: EU regulators warn that long-term use of desogestrel mini-pills and etonogestrel implants and rings carries a small meningioma risk
items.why: If you have used a desogestrel pill or etonogestrel implant or ring for a year or more, the meningioma risk rises with duration (about 1 extra case per 67,300 users, and 3.3-fold higher after other progestogens) — these contraceptives are now contraindicated after any meningioma, and the risk returns to baseline a year after stopping.

items.title: DUMOS nine-drawer dressers recalled for tip-over and entrapment risk to children
items.why: If yours is not anchored to the wall, put it out of children's reach and claim the full refund.

items.title: Hampton Bay Halwin 52-inch ceiling fans recalled after blades separated from the motor
items.why: Stop using the fan and claim either a refund or a Home Depot gift card from Youngo.

items.title: Microsoft Entra ID makes passkeys the default and begins retiring SMS and voice sign-in
items.why: If your organisation still signs in by SMS or voice code, move users to passkeys before 1 September or they are auto-enrolled and prompted.

items.title: FDA approves Orzeyful, the first drug treating narcolepsy type 1 as a whole disorder
items.why: It targets the orexin loss that causes the disease rather than treating individual symptoms.

items.title: FDA approves Lipfendra, the first PCSK9 cholesterol inhibitor available as a tablet
items.why: PCSK9 treatment no longer requires injections; it is now a once-daily oral tablet.
